title: SOAP integrations: a SOAP client from its WSDL on O11 with the declarative op soap (the Studio's own importer, incremental); SOAP on ODC is a declared gap

capabilities.title: SOAP service import from a WSDL (O11): the op soap imports the chosen methods with the Studio's own importer
capabilities.summary: Op soap (wsdl, port or service/binding/soapVersion, methods, refresh, remove, breaks): the deliver pins the WSDL with its imports; the kernel selects the SOAP port before any change (AMBIGUOUS_SOAP_PORT lists every choice, SOAP_METHOD_NOT_FOUND the operations); o11_deliver runs the Studio's importer in the bridge on a copy of the module with only the requested methods; the candidate keeps the exact WSDL types (SOAP_CONTRACT_TYPE_MISMATCH) and is merged once. Existing methods are skipped; refresh imports them again; remove takes the unused structures too.

route.operation: op soap {wsdl, port, methods} (api --op soap) through o11_deliver (bridge integration_import, then one merge); ssam_job/o11_job without the Studio answer INTEGRATION_IMPORT_NEEDS_STUDIO; a bridge without integration_import:wsdl answers INTEGRATION_IMPORT_NEEDS_BRIDGE before the snapshot

capabilities.guidance: Name the methods exactly as the WSDL names its operations and, when the WSDL has several SOAP ports, the port (or binding / soapVersion). Call a method from logic as any action (call ISOAPAction:<Method>, args by input name). Removing a method needs the user's words naming it and every consumer breaks lists; a standing grant never covers it. When the provider also offers a REST/JSON endpoint, integration.rest-consume needs no import.

limits.text: Declared, not proven live: the import runs in the bridge (integration_import:wsdl) on a detached copy with the PluginWorkspace of the tab; the bridge loads with the next Service Studio opened. GitSSAM proved the native importer live (CountryInfoService, 4 methods, identical rerun without change).
The native WSDL importer may resolve absolute imports itself from the Studio machine; the deliver pins and passes them, the importer is not proven to use only the pinned copies.

unavailable.reason: ODC apps do not consume SOAP through this kernel: the op soap answers SOAP_LANE_UNSUPPORTED on ODC. An ODC binary declares SOAP consumption removed, while the ODC Studio still ships the SOAP plugin; no route is proven.
unavailable.alternative: integration.rest-consume through a REST facade of the service, or an External Library that calls it (integration.external-library-odc)
